criteria.requirement: Phase 01 retains unresolved R1 at D2.
criteria.pass_when: Identifies that (2,3,1) becomes (3,3,1) on blocked F, keeps R1 open and withholds readiness despite preserved heading.
criteria.fail_when: Closes R1 after checking heading alone, accepting corrupted position.

criteria.requirement: Phase 02 rechecks the entire invariant at D3.
criteria.pass_when: Verifies both coordinates and heading remain unchanged, failure is reported and later commands continue; closes R1 with D3 evidence unless another concrete blocker is found.
criteria.fail_when: Carries an obsolete D2 defect into D3 or closes R1 without checking the full pose.

criteria.requirement: Tie each verdict to identifiable content and preserve rounds.
criteria.pass_when: Round 1 remains available; each report identifies document revision plus hash or exact reviewed excerpt, with current status before history.
criteria.fail_when: Overwrites failed recheck evidence or cites only HEAD for differing overlaid documents.

criteria.requirement: Separate static review from execution and human acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: Reports document-level verification only and edits reports rather than product artifacts.
criteria.fail_when: Claims runtime tests or human approval from the scripted corrected document.
